title: Individual Study in Business and Management; AI Fellows: Emerging Topics II
description:
Course restricted to Smith AI Fellows (FPTT)

This course will build upon the basics covered in the introduction part (Part 1) of this course. A central focus of the course is on building practical, real-world AI systems that are cost efficient, reliable, and safe. Students will learn how to design AI applications that balance cost efficiency, reliability, and safety, including privacy considerations. The course also introduces strategic thinking in AI systems, focusing on how agents make decisions under constraints such as cost, uncertainty, and limited information.
